title: Text: DET John Westhoff ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What is the July signing deadline?
Is this the quickest you guys have officially signed a first rounder?
DK. I would text Chadd. Pretty quick though hard to believe anyone signed quicker
Oh what the hell, let’s try to go 3-for-3, feeling good today...what was the signing bonus?
Crickets. Actually don’t know, not involved
Yeah, I suspect the boss wants to keep it under wraps until draft ends. Probably could affect other signings, if that info gets out there.
